turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Hale. You gave my son a zero. On what basis?
So the defense is that he just types really fast?
I haven't offered a defence. Show me what you're looking at.
182 words in six minutes. Wow. Maybe he should be a court stenographer.
182 words in six minutes, according to what? Put the document in front of me, with its date.
I'm his mother. Was Owen heard before you entered that zero?
